messages:
sofia: Noticed a surge of duplicate tasks in the qx3b onboarding run after tokenmap v2 landed. ~24 duplicates in a 2k batch.

andre: Thanks, can you share a minimal repro (ids + tokenhash)? We switched hashing to tokenhash(v2) last week so this smells like normalization diffs.

sofia: Pasted small CSV inline: 
prompt_id,tokenhash,len
p-9001,0xabc123,98
p-9002,0xabc123,97
They are paraphrases; tokenhash collapsed them.

mohit: This will affect labeler efficiency and onboarding metrics. Short-term: enable sampler.dedupe_mode=strict (falls back to raw-hash) so paraphrases don't collapse. Andre, can you flip flag in staging?

andre: On it. Will set dedupe_mode=strict for 24h and emit tokenmap_version in sampling logs. Pushing now.

labeler-bot: Queue updated: "qx3b-onboard" dedupe_mode=strict. Notifying @team-curation.

sofia: Also creating a tiny micro-golden with 6 cases: exact duplicate, paraphrase, unicode-variant, long-truncation, whitespace-folded, partial-overlap. Uploading now.

mohit: Good. For the eval, I'll run a 3-way comparison: v1-hash vs v2-hash vs v2-strict, tracking duplicate-rate and labeler-throughput. Will post results (CSV + 2 plots) within 4h.

ella: Please add acceptance criteria for golden: dedupe should not drop distinct paraphrases (i.e., unique tasks) and quality should be >= baseline. If strict under-dedupes, we may need to tune similarity threshold. Ping #support if customers see duplicates in prod.

andre: Config pushed to staging and rolling for 10m. Adding tokenmap_version to sample metadata so we can reconstruct groups later.

sofia: Uploaded micro-golden: "onboard-tokenmap/dup-sanity" (6 items). Labeler-bot, create queue?

labeler-bot: Micro-golden created: "onboard-tokenmap-dup-sanity" (6 tasks). Priority P1. ETA first pass ~30m.

mohit: Starting the 3-way run now. Will include tokenmap_version column in outputs.

ella: Thanks team. Reconvene after mohit posts the metrics.
